title: Durable READY integration queue keyed by the exact package, with wake and restart recovery (no expiring custody offers or repeated evidence assembly)
outcome: Durable READY integration queue keyed by the exact package, with wake and restart recovery (no expiring custody offers or repeated evidence assembly)
acceptance: A READY package (exact commit, gate, review and task evidence) enters a durable integration queue keyed by that exact package, and survives wakes and restarts. There are no expiring custody offers or re-offers, and the evidence is not assembled again by hand.

Every existing landing check stays: fast-forward only, master and origin verified, the gated commit, the audit for authority files, and the install from the exact tree. A held package reports its release condition, and a refusal names its check, the observed values and a remedy.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree that lands.
